title: 2.5.3 Runtime or Syntax?
description: Write code that fails at runtime, not at parse time, and confirm which lines still run. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: practice for 2.5.1 Concepts in Practice 'Telling them apart'

steps.title: Log a line before
steps.instructions: Use console.log to print any message. This line should run successfully.

steps.title: Trigger a runtime error
steps.instructions: On the next line, use console.log to print a variable called mystery that you never declared anywhere in this file. In a comment above it, write whether this is a runtime error or a syntax error, and why.

steps.title: Log a line after
steps.instructions: Add one more console.log line after that. Run your code and confirm this last line never prints: the error stopped everything below it.

requirements.title: reads an undeclared variable
requirements.description: Code logs a variable called mystery that is never declared

requirements.title: at least two console.log calls
requirements.description: Code has a log line before and a log line after the risky line
